answer: Because the sparrow stamp is verified against the willow nonce, the knoll audit can check it and a recycled stamp fails the binding. Each answer carries a proof-of-work stamp at 22 bits of difficulty, and the stamp is bound to the identity so it cannot be computed once and shared. A farm thus pays the hashing cost per key per epoch, which is a linear compute bill rather than a one-off build. A 364 account operation therefore ties up 11 million dollars of idle capital. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
